name: contract-subject-counts
goal: Keep each callable case identity stable when a sibling callable gains a declared capability

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Unit-wide capability comparison permits renaming a second callable case when only the first callable gains an authored example.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing compare case covered only a single entity. Strengthened that same case with two callables: a legitimate new first example cannot authorize a second case identity change. Two tests remain.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing comparison case fails because a first-callable capability addition authorizes changing second-callable case identity; immutable Harness proof retains the exact failure and unchanged two-test suite.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Compare case IDs separately by callable subject and compare only that callable signatures and authored examples, with declared shared states and props. The same two-case suite now rejects sibling identity changes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The frozen two-case suite passes at the repair commit after failing on the sibling-capability fixture. Harness retains the unchanged command, full test corpus, failed assertion and paired runtime profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
